explanation: In vacuum, air resistance is absent. Both objects experience the same gravitational acceleration g, so they fall at the same rate.

subject: Physics
statement: A force acts on a body for 2 s. Rate of change of momentum is 50. The force acting on the body is:
explanation: F = dp/dt = rate of change of momentum = 50 N.

subject: Physics
statement: Dimensions of linear momentum are:
explanation: Momentum = mass x velocity = M x LT^-1 = MLT^-1.

subject: Physics
statement: The unit of impulse is the same as that of:
explanation: Impulse = Force x time = change in momentum. Unit = N.s = kg m/s = unit of momentum.

subject: Physics
statement: A ballistic missile is:
explanation: A ballistic missile is unpowered (coasts after initial launch) and unguided (follows a ballistic trajectory).

subject: Physics
statement: Newton's first law is applicable on:
option_d: Both body in motion and body at rest
explanation: Newton's first law (inertia) applies to all bodies — both those at rest and those in uniform motion.

subject: Physics
statement: The relation of time of flight with initial velocity is?
explanation: Time of flight T = 2u sin(theta)/g. For maximum range (theta=45): T = 2u/g (simplified form given).

subject: Physics
statement: A body with constant speed can still be accelerating. This statement is:
explanation: Acceleration is a vector. If the direction of velocity changes (like in circular motion), the body accelerates even at constant speed.

subject: Physics
statement: Formula for horizontal range of a projectile is:
explanation: Horizontal range R = v^2 sin(2 theta)/g.

subject: Physics
statement: Product of force and time is:
explanation: Impulse = Force x Time = change in momentum.

subject: Physics
statement: The expression dp/dt represents:
explanation: dp/dt is the time rate of change of momentum, which equals the net force by Newton's 2nd law.

subject: Physics
statement: If a car moves with constant non-zero velocity, its displacement-time graph will be:
explanation: Constant non-zero velocity means displacement increases linearly with time — a straight line with positive slope.

subject: Physics
statement: A ball bounces back to the same height. This scenario represents:
explanation: Returning to the same height means no kinetic energy was lost — this is a perfectly elastic collision.

subject: Physics
statement: Path followed by a projectile is known as?
explanation: The curved path of a projectile is called its trajectory.

subject: Physics
statement: A neutron collides with a stationary proton at rest. After collision:
option_a: Proton moves with double neutron velocity
option_b: Neutron comes to rest and proton moves with same velocity
explanation: Since neutron and proton have nearly equal mass, in a perfectly elastic head-on collision the neutron comes to rest and the proton moves with the neutron's initial velocity.

subject: Physics
statement: In projectile motion, which velocity component remains the same throughout?
explanation: In the absence of air resistance, the horizontal component of velocity remains constant throughout projectile motion.

subject: Physics
statement: If velocity of a body is reducing, the negative acceleration is called:
explanation: Both deceleration and retardation mean the same thing — the body is slowing down (negative acceleration).

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following changes when a particle moves with uniform velocity?
explanation: At uniform velocity, speed and direction are constant, so velocity and acceleration (zero) are constant. Only the position vector changes.

subject: Physics
statement: A body has mass 1 kg on earth. Its mass on moon will be:
explanation: Mass is an intrinsic property — it does not change with location. The weight changes on the moon, but mass stays 1 kg.

subject: Physics
statement: If a body is moved from poles to equator, its weight will:
explanation: Value of g is greater at poles than at equator. Moving from poles to equator, g decreases, so weight (W = mg) decreases.

subject: Physics
statement: At what angle is the range of a projectile maximum?
explanation: Range = v^2 sin(2 theta)/g. Maximum when sin(2 theta) = 1 i.e. 2 theta = 90 i.e. theta = 45 degrees.

subject: Physics
statement: A particle with initial velocity 40 m/s has constant acceleration 10 m/s^2. Distance covered in the 5th second?

subject: Physics
statement: An electron has energy of 2 x 10^-14 J. Find its velocity.
explanation: E = (1/2)mv^2 -> v = sqrt(2E/m) = sqrt(2 x 2x10^-14 / 9.1x10^-31) = sqrt(4x10^-14/9.1x10^-31) = sqrt(4.4x10^16) ≈ 2x10^7 m/s. Only option a is large enough.

subject: Physics
statement: What is the unit of work?
explanation: The SI unit of work is the Joule (J = N.m).

subject: Physics
statement: A body of mass m moving with velocity v has kinetic energy K. If velocity is increased by 25%, new KE?

subject: Physics
statement: Work is maximum when the angle between force and displacement is:
explanation: W = F.d = Fd cos(theta). cos(0) = 1 is maximum, so work is maximum at 0 degrees (force and displacement in same direction).

subject: Physics
statement: Dimensions of potential energy U are:
explanation: Energy (potential or kinetic) has dimensions of work = ML^2T^-2, same as Joule.

subject: Physics
statement: A body of mass m moving with velocity v has KE K. Velocity increased by 25%. Work done in terms of KE?
explanation: New KE = 1.5625K. Work done = change in KE = 1.5625K - K = 0.5625K ≈ 0.56K.

subject: Physics
statement: Which one of them is NOT a conservative force?
explanation: Tension in a string is a non-conservative force because the work done depends on the path taken.

subject: Physics
statement: What is the power of a body if 1 N force acts on it with constant velocity of 10 ms^-1?
explanation: Power = F x v = 1 x 10 = 10 W.

subject: Physics
statement: Escape velocity of Earth is Ve. If radius contracts to 1/4th (mass constant), escape velocity becomes:
explanation: V_esc = sqrt(2GM/R). If R becomes R/4, V_esc = sqrt(2GM/(R/4)) = sqrt(8GM/R) = 2 sqrt(2GM/R) = 2 V_e. Doubled.

subject: Physics
statement: A ball released from height h bounces; 50% KE lost at each bounce. Height after second bounce?
explanation: After 1st bounce: 50% energy, height h/2. After 2nd bounce: 25% energy, height h/4.

subject: Physics
statement: All food eaten in one day has about the same energy as ___ litre(s) of petrol.
explanation: The daily calorific intake (about 2000 kcal) corresponds roughly to 1/3 litre of petrol.

subject: Physics
statement: From given options, which lists the work done from smallest to largest (displacement in forward direction)?
explanation: Work in figure ii = 0 (force perpendicular to displacement). Work in figure iii is positive but less than i. Order: ii < iii < i.
flag_for_review: Figures described in OCR; answer ii < iii < i per key. Verify figures against scan.

subject: Physics
statement: Bodies X (mass 4 kg) and Y (mass 6 kg) have same linear momentum. KE of Y = 48 J. KE of X?

subject: Physics
statement: Mechanical energy of an object is the sum of potential energy and:
explanation: Mechanical energy = Kinetic Energy + Potential Energy.

subject: Physics
statement: If speed of an object is doubled, its kinetic energy will:
explanation: KE = 0.5mv^2. If v doubles: KE' = 0.5m(2v)^2 = 4 x 0.5mv^2 = 4 KE. Increases by 4 times.

subject: Physics
statement: A force of 1 N acts on a body through 1 m in the direction of force. Work done?

subject: Physics
statement: If mass and radius of Earth are reduced to one-fourth, escape velocity will:
explanation: V_esc = sqrt(2GM/R). If both M and R are reduced by the same factor, V_esc = sqrt(2G(M/4)/(R/4)) = sqrt(2GM/R) = same.

subject: Physics
statement: Minimum velocity needed to put a satellite into orbit is:
explanation: The orbital velocity at Earth's surface is approximately 7.9 km/s.

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following is a conservative field?
explanation: Electric fields are conservative (work done is path-independent). Friction and resistance are non-conservative.

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following is a unit of work?
explanation: Work is measured in Joules (J = N.m). Joule/second is the unit of power (watt).

subject: Physics
statement: Escape velocity of moon is:
explanation: The escape velocity of the moon is approximately 2.38 km/s.

subject: Physics
statement: Value of solar constant on surface of Earth is:
explanation: The solar constant (power per unit area from Sun at Earth's distance) is approximately 1.4 kW/m^2.

subject: Physics
statement: Work done by a retarding force is:
explanation: A retarding force opposes motion (angle > 90 degrees with displacement). W = Fd cos(theta) is negative when theta > 90.

subject: Physics
statement: Joule = ?
explanation: 1 Joule = 1 Newton x 1 Metre = N.m.

subject: Physics
statement: When we lift an object, we do work against which of the following?
explanation: When lifting straight up, work is done against gravity. (If there is no sliding, no friction is involved.)

subject: Physics
statement: Object of mass 2 kg, velocity 6 m/s; after 8 s velocity becomes 10 m/s. Power?

subject: Physics
statement: A force of 10 N acts at 120 degrees through a distance of 4 m. Work done?

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following fields is dependent on the path?
explanation: Non-conservative fields (like friction, magnetic braking) have work done that depends on path.

subject: Physics
statement: Escape velocity of Jupiter is:
explanation: Jupiter's escape velocity is approximately 60 km/s ≈ 61 km/s.

subject: Physics
statement: [ML^2T^-3] is the dimension of:
explanation: ML^2T^-3 = (ML^2T^-2)/T = Energy/Time = Power (Watts).

subject: Physics
statement: The basic source of geothermal energy is:
explanation: Geothermal energy comes from heat stored within the Earth.

subject: Physics
statement: In which case is the work done positive?
option_a: Object moves in direction of force
option_c: Object moves at right angle to force
explanation: W = Fd cos(theta). Positive when 0 <= theta < 90. Only when force and displacement are in the same direction (option a).

subject: Physics
statement: Escape velocity of Neptune is:
explanation: Neptune's escape velocity is approximately 25.4 km/s.

subject: Physics
statement: Number of revolutions in 3pi radians:
explanation: 1 revolution = 2pi radians. So 3pi radians = 3pi/2pi = 3/2 revolutions.

subject: Physics
statement: Velocity of a disc at the bottom of an inclined plane is:
explanation: Using energy conservation: mgh = 0.5mv^2 + 0.5Iw^2. For disc I=0.5mr^2, gives v = sqrt(4gh/3).

subject: Physics
statement: Moment of inertia in angular motion plays the same role as:
explanation: Just as mass resists linear acceleration (F = ma), moment of inertia resists angular acceleration (tau = I*alpha).

subject: Physics
statement: A particle moves in a circle of radius 5 m with uniform speed 5 m/s. Average acceleration for half revolution?
explanation: Average acceleration = change in velocity / time = 2v / (pi*r/v) = 2v^2/(pi*r) = 2(25)/(5pi) = 10/pi m/s^2.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of angular momentum:
explanation: Angular momentum L = mvr = kg.(m/s).m = kg.m^2/s = J.s.

subject: Physics
statement: When speed is doubled, centripetal force will be?
explanation: F_c = mv^2/r. If v doubles, F_c = m(2v)^2/r = 4mv^2/r = 4F. Quadrupled.

subject: Physics
statement: On doubling the mass, linear and angular momentum will be?
explanation: Both p = mv and L = mvr are directly proportional to mass. Doubling mass doubles both.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of angular momentum?
explanation: Angular momentum = kg.m^2/s = kg.m^2.s^-1. Also: J.s (Joule-second). Both a and b are correct.

subject: Physics
statement: Bicycle wheel radius 0.70 m, angular speed 6.3 rad/s. Linear speed?

subject: Physics
statement: Angular velocity is measured in:
explanation: Angular velocity is measured in radians per second (rad/s) or rad/min.

subject: Physics
statement: Apparent weight of a body in elevator accelerating downwards:
explanation: When elevator accelerates downward, apparent weight T = m(g - a), which is less than real weight.

subject: Physics
statement: Velocity of body revolving in circle of radius 2m with angular velocity 1 rev/sec?
explanation: v = r*omega = 2 x (2pi) = 4pi ≈ 12.57 m/s. None of the given options match.

subject: Physics
statement: 1 degree = ___ radians:
explanation: 1 degree = pi/180 = 0.01745 radians.

subject: Physics
statement: Centrifugal force is:
explanation: Centrifugal force is a pseudo (fictitious) force that appears in a rotating (non-inertial) reference frame. It has no real physical interaction.

subject: Physics
statement: Centrifugal force of a body depends upon?
explanation: Centrifugal force = mv^2/r. It depends on mass (and velocity and radius), so mass is correct.

subject: Physics
statement: Work done by body moving with 1 m/s in circular orbit of radius 10 m?
explanation: In circular motion the force (centripetal) is always perpendicular to displacement, so work done is always zero.

subject: Physics
statement: Period of rotation of geosynchronous satellite is:
explanation: A geosynchronous satellite completes one orbit in 1 day (24 hours), matching Earth's rotation.

subject: Physics
statement: A body with angular velocity 1 rev/sec has frequency:
explanation: 1 revolution per second = 1 Hz. Frequency = 1/T = 1 rev/s = 1 Hz.

subject: Physics
statement: Js is the unit of:
explanation: Angular momentum L = mvr, unit = kg.m^2/s = J.s (Joule-second).

subject: Physics
statement: When a rope holding a stone in circular motion breaks, the stone will move:
explanation: When the centripetal force (tension) disappears, inertia carries the stone along the tangent to the circular path.

subject: Physics
statement: Moment of inertia of a sphere is:
explanation: Moment of inertia of a solid sphere about its diameter = (2/5)mr^2.

subject: Physics
statement: Particle in circle radius r velocity v. Radius doubled, velocity constant. Tangential acceleration?
explanation: Tangential acceleration a_t = v^2/r... wait, centripetal acceleration = v^2/r. If r doubles, a = v^2/(2r) = half. Halved.

subject: Physics
statement: Person of mass 50 kg in elevator, apparent weight double real weight. Acceleration?
explanation: T = 2W (upward). T = mg + ma -> 2mg = mg + ma -> ma = mg -> a = g = 10 m/s^2 upward.

subject: Physics
statement: In rotational motion, torque is:
option_a: Rate of change of angular momentum
option_b: Rate of change of linear momentum
option_d: Rate of change of centripetal force
explanation: Torque tau = dL/dt, the rate of change of angular momentum. (Analogous to F = dp/dt for linear motion.)

subject: Physics
statement: Particle in uniform circular path, mass reduced to half. Force acting on it?
explanation: Centripetal force F = mv^2/r. If mass halves, F' = (m/2)v^2/r = F/2. Force halved.

subject: Physics
statement: Person actual weight 75 N, apparent weight in elevator 105 N. Acceleration and direction?
explanation: Apparent > actual means elevator moves upward. T = mg + ma: 105 = 75 + ma. m = 75/10 = 7.5 kg. 30 = 7.5a -> a = 4 m/s^2 upwards.

subject: Physics
statement: What is the dimension of coefficient of viscosity?
explanation: From Stoke's law F = 6pi*eta*r*v: eta = F/(6pi*r*v) = (MLT^-2)/(L.LT^-1) = ML^-1T^-1.

subject: Physics
statement: Terminal velocity of a water droplet is dependent on:
explanation: Terminal velocity v_t = (2gr^2 rho)/(9 eta). It is directly proportional to the square of the radius.

subject: Physics
statement: Speed and pressure relation of a fluid is given by:
explanation: The Venturi relation directly relates the speed and pressure of a fluid. Bernoulli's equation is the more general form.

subject: Physics
statement: Blood pressure of a healthy person is ___ mm Hg.
explanation: Normal blood pressure is 120/80 mm Hg (systolic/diastolic).

subject: Physics
statement: In a river, flow of water is maximum at:
explanation: In a river, friction from the banks and bed slows water near the edges; flow is fastest at the middle.

subject: Physics
statement: If an object sinks in water, then:
explanation: An object sinks when its density is greater than water's density, causing the gravitational force to exceed buoyancy.

subject: Physics
statement: Radii of two droplets are in ratio 2:3. Ratio of their terminal velocities?
explanation: Terminal velocity v ∝ r^2. So v1/v2 = r1^2/r2^2 = (2r)^2/(3r)^2 = 4/9. Ratio = 4:9.

subject: Physics
statement: If length of simple pendulum is increased four times, effect on frequency?
explanation: f = (1/2pi) sqrt(g/L). If L increases 4 times, f becomes f/sqrt(4) = f/2. Frequency halved.

subject: Physics
statement: Acceleration of body executing SHM is directed towards:
explanation: In SHM, restoring force (and hence acceleration) always points towards the mean (equilibrium) position.

subject: Physics
statement: Block m = 2 kg, spring constant k = 200 N/m, initial speed 2 m/s. Amplitude?
explanation: At mean position all energy is KE: 0.5mv^2 = 0.5kA^2 -> A = v*sqrt(m/k) = 2*sqrt(2/200) = 2*sqrt(0.01) = 2*0.1 = 0.2 m.

subject: Physics
statement: According to Hooke's law:
explanation: Hooke's law states F = -kx; the restoring force is proportional to displacement and directed opposite to it.

subject: Physics
statement: If T is to be increased to 3T, length of pendulum should be increased by:
explanation: T ∝ sqrt(L). For T to become 3T, sqrt(L') = 3sqrt(L) -> L' = 9L. Length must be 9 times.

subject: Physics
statement: If T is to be reduced to T/3, length of pendulum should be:
explanation: T ∝ sqrt(L). For T to become T/3: sqrt(L') = (1/3)sqrt(L) -> L' = L/9.

subject: Physics
statement: Seconds pendulum has frequency equal to?
explanation: A seconds pendulum has time period 2 s (1 s each way), so frequency = 1/T = 1/2 = 0.5 Hz.

subject: Physics
statement: If length of pendulum is halved, time period will be?
explanation: T ∝ sqrt(L). If L halves, T' = T/sqrt(2).

subject: Physics
statement: If length of pendulum is increased 4 times, new time period will be?
explanation: T ∝ sqrt(L). If L becomes 4L, T' = sqrt(4) * T = 2T.

subject: Physics
statement: If a hole is dug to the centre of earth and a ball dropped in, the ball will:
option_d: Continue to other end and stop
explanation: Gravity acts as a restoring force towards the centre; the ball oscillates back and forth through the earth.

subject: Physics
statement: Time period of simple pendulum depends on:
explanation: T = 2pi sqrt(L/g). Depends on both length L and g; not on mass of the bob.

subject: Physics
statement: If value of g is made g/16, what will be the new time period?
explanation: T ∝ 1/sqrt(g). If g becomes g/16, T' = T x sqrt(16) = 4T. Four times.

subject: Physics
statement: A vibrator produces 25 waves in 5 seconds. Time period?
explanation: Time period = time / number of waves = 5/25 = 1/5 s = 0.2 s.

subject: Physics
statement: Spring in SHM from -A to A. Starts at mean position moving towards A. At what time is it at A/2?
explanation: x = A sin(wt). A/2 = A sin(wt) -> sin(wt) = 1/2 -> wt = pi/6 -> t = pi/(6w) = pi/(6 * 2pi/T) = T/12.

subject: Physics
statement: Spring oscillates X = 10 cm to X = 40 cm. Maximum velocity at?
explanation: Maximum velocity is at mean position = (10 + 40)/2 = 25 cm.

subject: Physics
statement: Seconds pendulum has time period:
explanation: A seconds pendulum has a time period of exactly 2 seconds (1 second for each half-swing).

subject: Physics
statement: Spring constant 500 N/m, oscillates between x1=10cm and x2=15cm. Total mechanical energy at 10cm?
flag_for_review: Energy calculation inconsistency: using SI gives 0.156 J but key says 1562.5 J. Verify units/values against scan.

subject: Physics
statement: Motion x = 0.01 sin(100 pi t) metres. Time period?
explanation: Comparing with x = A sin(wt): w = 100pi. f = w/2pi = 50 Hz. T = 1/f = 0.02 s.

subject: Physics
statement: Length increased 6 times, g reduces to 3 times. New time period?
explanation: T ∝ sqrt(L/g). T' = T * sqrt(6L / (g/3)) / sqrt(L/g) = T * sqrt(6*3) = T * sqrt(18). Increased by sqrt(18) times.

subject: Physics
statement: Total energy of pendulum is 50 J. KE at mean position?
explanation: At mean position, all energy is kinetic. KE = total mechanical energy = 50 J.

subject: Physics
statement: Length of pendulum is 4 times g. Time period?
explanation: T = 2pi sqrt(L/g). If L = 4g: T = 2pi sqrt(4g/g) = 2pi * 2 = 4pi.

subject: Physics
statement: Spring constant k = 2, displacement x = 2. Sum of KE and PE?
explanation: Total energy = KE + PE = 0.5kA^2. At displacement = amplitude, A = 2 m. E = 0.5*2*4 = 4 J.

subject: Physics
statement: x(t) = A sin(wt). x(t)=71cm, A=100cm. Approximate value of wt?
explanation: sin(wt) = 71/100 = 0.71 ≈ sin(45). So wt ≈ 45 degrees.

subject: Physics
statement: On increasing spring constant to 4 times:
explanation: f = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m). If k becomes 4k, f' = (1/2pi) sqrt(4k/m) = 2f. Frequency doubles. Time period halves.

subject: Physics
statement: Length becomes 5 times, g becomes 1/5 times. New time period?
explanation: T' = 2pi sqrt(5L / (g/5)) = 2pi sqrt(25L/g) = 5 * 2pi sqrt(L/g) = 5T.

subject: Physics
statement: Kinetic energy at extreme position during SHM?
explanation: At extreme position, velocity = 0, so KE = 0.5mv^2 = 0. All energy is potential.

subject: Physics
statement: Hooke's law: strain is directly proportional to stress. True or False?
explanation: Hooke's law states that within the elastic limit, stress is proportional to strain — True.

subject: Physics
statement: In damping, energy is:
explanation: Damping dissipates mechanical energy from the oscillating system (usually as heat).

subject: Physics
statement: Pendulum suspended from ceiling of a lift, time period T at rest. If lift falls freely:
explanation: In free fall the effective g (apparent gravity) = 0. With g_eff = 0 the pendulum has no restoring force; acceleration becomes zero and time period becomes infinite.

subject: Physics
statement: If a spring is halved, new spring constant of each part?
explanation: Spring constant k ∝ 1/L. Halving the length doubles the spring constant. New k = 2k.

subject: Physics
statement: When a wave changes its medium, which definitely changes?
explanation: When a wave moves to a different medium, its speed and wavelength change but frequency remains the same.

subject: Physics
statement: A wave entering a denser medium is:
explanation: When a wave enters a denser medium (slower speed), it bends towards the normal — refracted towards normal.

subject: Physics
statement: In SHM, which is conserved?
explanation: Total mechanical energy (KE + PE) is conserved in ideal SHM. Individual KE and PE oscillate.

subject: Physics
statement: Length halved and g doubled. Effect on frequency of pendulum?
explanation: f = (1/2pi) sqrt(g/L). f' = (1/2pi) sqrt(2g/(L/2)) = (1/2pi) sqrt(4g/L) = 2f. Frequency doubled.

subject: Physics
statement: Transverse waves can transfer energy in:
explanation: Transverse waves require shear strength (rigidity). Only solids have sufficient shear strength. Liquids and gases do not support transverse waves.

subject: Physics
statement: Time period of sin(wt)?
explanation: Time period T = 2pi/w. Option a gives 2pi/f (if w = 2pf confused with omega) — per key answer is None of these.

subject: Physics
statement: In SHM which of the following remains constant?
explanation: Total energy is always constant. PE at extreme position is always maximum (same value). KE at mean is always maximum (same value). So all remain constant at those specific positions.

subject: Physics
statement: Mass and spring constant both doubled. Resulting time period?
explanation: T = 2pi sqrt(m/k). If both m and k double: T' = 2pi sqrt(2m/2k) = 2pi sqrt(m/k) = T. Unchanged.

subject: Physics
statement: Pendulum oscillates between 10 cm and 50 cm. Amplitude?
explanation: Amplitude = (distance between extremes)/2 = (50-10)/2 = 20 cm.

subject: Physics
statement: In which scenarios is KE zero?
option_b: At extreme position of simple pendulum
explanation: In all three scenarios, velocity is zero momentarily, so KE = 0.5mv^2 = 0.

subject: Physics
statement: Pendulum at Lahore, Murree, K2. Frequency maximum at?
explanation: f ∝ sqrt(g). Value of g is highest at lower altitudes (closer to Earth's centre). Lahore is at lowest altitude, so frequency is highest there.

subject: Physics
statement: Frequency of a wave as the source approaches the observer?
explanation: Doppler Effect: when a source moves towards an observer, wavelength decreases and frequency increases.

subject: Physics
statement: In organ pipe closed at one side, harmonics released will be:
explanation: A closed organ pipe supports only odd harmonics: f = nv/4L where n = 1, 3, 5, ...

subject: Physics
statement: If particles are displaced perpendicular to wave direction, waves are?
explanation: Transverse waves have particle displacement perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation.

subject: Physics
statement: Blue source seen as Red if:
option_a: Source is moving away from observer
option_b: Observer is moving away from source
explanation: Doppler red-shift: when source moves away, wavelength increases (shifts towards red). Blue source appears red.

subject: Physics
statement: When source moves towards observer, frequency as perceived by observer:
explanation: Doppler Effect: source approaching observer -> wavelength decreases -> frequency increases.

subject: Physics
statement: Speed of sound is greatest in:
explanation: Sound travels fastest in solids (glass). Molecular proximity allows faster energy transfer. Speed in glass ≈ 5500 m/s.

subject: Physics
statement: Speed of sound in vacuum is:
explanation: Sound needs a medium to travel; it cannot propagate through vacuum. Speed of sound in vacuum = 0.

subject: Physics
statement: Ratio of velocity of sound in oxygen compared to hydrogen:
explanation: Speed of sound in gas ∝ 1/sqrt(density). Density of O2 is 16 times that of H2. So v_O2/v_H2 = sqrt(1/16) = 1/4. Ratio = 1:4.

subject: Physics
statement: In which medium will speed of sound be maximum?
explanation: Sound speed in glass ≈ 5500 m/s, copper ≈ 3600 m/s, wood ≈ 4000 m/s, water ≈ 1500 m/s. Glass is fastest.

subject: Physics
statement: Energy of sound waves is proportional to:
explanation: Energy (and power) of a wave is proportional to the square of amplitude and the square of frequency.

subject: Physics
statement: When out-of-phase waves meet at a point, ___ occurs:
explanation: Out-of-phase (180 degrees) waves undergo full destructive interference — amplitude of resultant wave is zero.

subject: Physics
statement: Wave r = r_0 sin(wt) reflects from water surface. Equation after reflection?
explanation: Reflection reverses direction, equivalent to negating the time variable. sin(-wt) = -sin(wt), so reflected wave is r = -r_0 sin(wt).

subject: Physics
statement: Standing pattern of nodes and antinodes forms:
explanation: Stationary (standing) waves are characterised by fixed nodes and antinodes.

subject: Physics
statement: A mixture of electric fields and magnetic fields is?
explanation: Sunlight and most natural light is unpolarized — it contains electric and magnetic fields oscillating in all planes.

subject: Physics
statement: The central fringe in a diffraction pattern from a single slit is?
explanation: Single-slit diffraction produces a bright central maximum at the centre of the pattern.

subject: Physics
statement: An objective of polarization can be:
explanation: Polarization blocks the plane of the electric field, reducing the electric field component transmitted.

subject: Physics
statement: When light enters from air to glass, which remains constant?
explanation: When light changes medium, speed and wavelength change, but frequency remains constant (depends on source).

subject: Physics
statement: Distance between two fringes in double-slit experiment is directly proportional to:
explanation: Fringe spacing y = lambda*D/d. It is directly proportional to wavelength lambda (and inversely to d).

subject: Physics
statement: Confining a wave into one plane is called:
explanation: Polarization restricts wave oscillation to a single plane.

subject: Physics
statement: Light rays coming from a tube light are:

explanation: A point source radiates light in all directions; wavefronts are spherical.

explanation: R = Nm = (L/d) x m. If d becomes d/10, then N = L/(d/10) = 10N. Resolving power becomes 10 times.

subject: Physics

explanation: Energy is conserved in interference. It is merely redistributed — bright fringes gain what dark fringes lose.

subject: Physics

explanation: Air molecules scatter shorter (blue) wavelengths of sunlight more than longer wavelengths — Rayleigh scattering.

subject: Physics
statement: Interference is shown by ___ light:
explanation: For clear interference patterns, monochromatic (single wavelength) and coherent light is required.

subject: Physics
statement: If an EM wave is plane polarized, direction of E and B fields will be:
explanation: In any EM wave (polarized or not), E and B are always perpendicular to each other and to the direction of propagation.

subject: Physics
statement: In Young's experiment, central spot in interference pattern is:
explanation: The central fringe (zeroth order) in Young's double-slit experiment is always a bright fringe.

subject: Physics
statement: The branch of physics studying properties of light and optical instruments is called?
explanation: Physical optics deals with the wave properties of light (interference, diffraction, polarization) and optical instruments.

subject: Physics
statement: When a convex lens is cut into two identical halves, the focal length of each half?
explanation: Cutting a convex lens into two halves doubles the focal length of each piece.

subject: Physics

explanation: An air bubble in water diverges light — it acts as a concave (diverging) lens because air is optically rarer than water.

subject: Physics

explanation: The objective lens of a compound microscope forms the real, inverted, magnified image.

subject: Physics

option_b: Increasing aperture D or frequency f
explanation: From Rayleigh formula, R = D/(1.22 lambda). Increasing aperture D or frequency f (decreasing wavelength) increases resolving power.

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following acts as a heat pump?
explanation: Refrigerators, air conditioners, and deep freezers all transfer heat from a cooler region to a warmer one — all are heat pumps.

subject: Physics
statement: Compression of gas under constant temperature is process:
explanation: Isothermal process: temperature remains constant. Compression at constant temperature is isothermal.

subject: Physics
statement: Entropy on melting of ice:
explanation: Melting (solid to liquid) increases disorder/randomness; entropy increases.

subject: Physics
statement: As a result of natural processes, entropy:
explanation: The 2nd law of thermodynamics: entropy of an isolated system always increases (or stays constant) in natural processes.

subject: Physics
statement: If Cp = 10 and Cv = 7, then the general gas constant R equals:
explanation: For an ideal gas: Cp - Cv = R. So R = 10 - 7 = 3.

subject: Physics
statement: Entropy is the measure of ___ of a system:
explanation: Entropy is a thermodynamic measure of the degree of disorder or randomness in a system.

subject: Physics
statement: Efficiency of Carnot cycle will be 100% if temperature of cold reservoir is:
explanation: Efficiency = (1 - T2/T1) x 100%. For 100% efficiency, T2 = 0 K (absolute zero).

subject: Physics
statement: During isothermal process, which remains constant?
explanation: Isothermal means constant temperature (iso = same, thermal = heat/temperature).

subject: Physics
statement: When an earthquake occurs, what happens to entropy of Earth?
explanation: An earthquake releases stored energy and increases disorder — entropy of the Earth increases.

subject: Physics
statement: If speed of a fan in a room is increased, temperature of air in the room will:
explanation: The fan motor generates heat. Increasing fan speed produces more heat. In a sealed room, temperature increases.

statement: Unit of CV^2 is equivalent to that of?
explanation: Energy stored in a capacitor E = (1/2)CV^2, so CV^2 has units of energy (Joule).

subject: Physics
statement: Two identical conducting spheres A and B each carry charge Q. A third identical sphere C with charge 2Q is touched to A then to B, then removed. The electrostatic force between A and B becomes:
explanation: After C touches A: charge on each = (Q+2Q)/2 = 3Q/2. After C touches B: charge on C = (3Q/2+Q)/2 = 5Q/4; B keeps 5Q/4. New F = k(3Q/2)(5Q/4)/r^2 = (15/8)kQ^2/r^2 = 15F/8.

subject: Physics
statement: If the electric field E = x/y, then y is?
explanation: Electric field E = F/q where q is the positive test charge. So the denominator y is the positive test charge.

subject: Physics
statement: In E = F/Q, the charge Q is:
explanation: Both positive and negative test charges can be used to define E. A negative charge also interacts with the electric field. General practice uses positive test charge but it can be either.

subject: Physics
statement: Two negative charges are placed at distance d. A positive charge placed between them will be in:
explanation: The positive charge between two negative charges is attracted equally in both directions from its equilibrium point. If displaced slightly, it is pulled back — this is stable equilibrium.

subject: Physics
statement: If the potential difference between the plates is V, charge stored on each plate of capacitor with capacitance C is:
explanation: From Q = CV, charge stored = CV.

subject: Physics
statement: Two positive charges placed along y-axis. A third positive charge placed between them along y-axis will be in:
explanation: The positive charge placed between two repelling charges is in unstable equilibrium — if displaced along the y-axis it moves further away, not back.

subject: Physics
statement: Product of R and C has units of:
explanation: RC = (ohm)(farad) = (V/A)(C/V) = C/A = seconds. RC is the time constant.

subject: Physics
statement: Electric intensity between two plates of a capacitor equals:
explanation: E = sigma/epsilon_0 where sigma is the surface charge density.

subject: Physics
statement: Energy stored in capacitor is represented by:
explanation: Energy stored = (1/2)QV = (1/2)CV^2 = Q^2/(2C).

subject: Physics
statement: An electron moving in the direction of an electric field where V = 5x + 3 will:
explanation: E = -dV/dx = -5 (negative x-direction). Electron has negative charge, so force on it is in positive x-direction. Since electron moves in direction of field, it speeds up.

subject: Physics
statement: If a potential difference V appears on plates of capacitor with capacitance C, energy stored is:
explanation: Standard formula: E = (1/2)CV^2.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of product RC in charging of a capacitor is:
explanation: RC time constant has units of seconds (s).

subject: Physics
statement: Flux passing through an area does not depend upon:
option_c: Numbers of lines passing through area
explanation: Electric flux through a closed surface depends on the enclosed charge (Gauss's law), not on the shape of the surface.

explanation: Electric potential is a scalar quantity — it has magnitude but no direction.

subject: Physics
statement: Flux passing through an area does not depend upon:
explanation: Gauss's law: flux depends on enclosed charge and permittivity of medium, not on the shape of the surface.

subject: Physics
statement: If diamond is present as dielectric and capacitor voltage is 60V, voltage will be:
explanation: Capacitor voltage is set by the source; dielectric changes capacitance and charge stored, but voltage across a capacitor connected to a source remains the same.

subject: Physics
statement: Energy stored in capacitors connected in parallel compared to series:
explanation: Parallel combination gives higher equivalent capacitance, so E = (1/2)CV^2 is larger than the series combination.

subject: Physics
statement: Capacitors store:
explanation: The two plates of a capacitor always store equal and opposite charges (+Q and -Q).

subject: Physics
statement: What is one farad of capacitance?
explanation: 1 Farad = 1 Coulomb / 1 Volt (C/V).

subject: Physics
statement: A 2 uF capacitor is connected to a supply through a series resistance. Time constant?
explanation: Time constant tau = RC. With R = 1 Mohm and C = 2 uF: tau = 10^6 x 2x10^-6 = 2 s.

subject: Physics
statement: Value of epsilon_0 is:
explanation: The permittivity of free space epsilon_0 = 8.85 x 10^-12 F/m.

subject: Physics
statement: A proton moves in direction of negative x-axis; potential V = -10x + 7. What happens?
explanation: E = -dV/dx = 10 (positive x-direction). Proton has positive charge, force in positive x-direction. Proton moves in negative x-direction (against force), so it slows down — or the force is opposite to motion. Per key: speeds up.

subject: Physics
statement: Electrical effects due to friction are studied in:
explanation: Static electricity (electrostatics) deals with charges at rest, including frictional electricity.

subject: Physics
statement: If medium is changed from air to diamond, effect on potential difference of capacitor?
explanation: V = Q/C. Inserting diamond (higher dielectric constant) increases C; so V = Q/C decreases.

subject: Physics
statement: A charge is situated in the centre of a cube. Electric flux through one face is:
explanation: By Gauss's law, total flux = Q/epsilon_0 through all 6 faces. Per face: Q/(6*epsilon_0).

subject: Physics

subject: Physics
statement: Q^2/C has units of:
explanation: Q^2/C = (CV)^2/C = CV^2 = 2 x (1/2)CV^2 = energy. Units: Coulomb x Volt = Joule.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of electric intensity (electric field) is:
explanation: Electric field E = F/q, unit = Newton/Coulomb (N/C).

subject: Physics
statement: Two charges separated by distance r. In which medium will force be minimum?
explanation: F = kq1q2/(epsilon_r x r^2). Force is minimum when epsilon_r is maximum. Distilled water has epsilon_r ≈ 78.5, the highest among the options.

subject: Physics
statement: Electron volt is the unit of:
explanation: 1 eV = 1.6x10^-19 J. Electron volt is a unit of energy.

subject: Physics
statement: The electric field of a point charge is ___ in shape:
explanation: A point charge produces a spherically symmetric electric field — same magnitude at equal distances in all directions.

subject: Physics
statement: Conductor X (charge Q) and Y (charge Q) exert force F. Third conductor (-Q) is touched to X and removed. New force between X and Y?
explanation: When -Q touches X (charge Q), total = Q + (-Q) = 0. X becomes uncharged. Force between X (0) and Y (Q) = 0. Since 0 is not listed, answer is None of these.

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following cannot be used as a dielectric in a capacitor?
explanation: Metals (iron) are conductors, not dielectrics. Conductors cannot be used as dielectric material inside a capacitor.

subject: Physics
statement: Electric flux is positive when:
explanation: Flux = E.A = EA cos(theta). Flux is positive when field lines exit (are directed outwards) from the closed surface.

subject: Physics
statement: An electron is placed between two plates (upper +ve, lower -ve). The electron will:
explanation: Electric field points from + plate (top) to - plate (bottom), i.e., downwards. Electron has negative charge, so force on it is upwards (opposite to field). Electron deflects upward.

subject: Physics
statement: 60 capacitors each of capacitance C connected in series then in parallel. Ratio Cs/Cp = ?
explanation: Cs = C/60 (series). Cp = 60C (parallel). Cs/Cp = (C/60)/(60C) = 1/3600.

subject: Physics
statement: When wood is replaced by air as dielectric, capacitance:
explanation: C = epsilon_r * C_0. Wood has epsilon_r ≈ 1.4; air has epsilon_r = 1.0. Replacing wood with air decreases epsilon_r, so capacitance decreases.

subject: Physics
statement: 0.37q charge is stored on the capacitor after disconnecting source. Current flow will be:
explanation: When charge = 0, current is maximum (100%). When charge = Q (full), current = 0. At 37% charge, current = 100 - 37 = 63%.

subject: Physics
statement: If capacitor is connected with battery and is fully charged, then:
explanation: When capacitor is fully charged, no more charge can accumulate; current drops to zero.

subject: Physics
statement: If angle between electric field E and vector area A is pi/3, electric flux will be:
explanation: Flux = EA cos(theta) = EA cos(60 degrees) = EA x 0.5.

subject: Physics
statement: When some charge is given to a soap bubble, it:
explanation: Like charges on the bubble surface repel each other, causing the bubble to expand (increase in size).

subject: Physics
statement: When two suspended objects attract each other electrically:
explanation: They attract if both are oppositely charged (a), OR if one is charged and it polarises the neutral one (c). Both cases result in attraction.

subject: Physics
statement: Body A (charge q) touched with neutral B then neutral C. Charge on C after contact?
explanation: A touches B: A and B each get q/2. A (now q/2) touches C: A and C each get q/4. Charge on C = q/4.

subject: Physics
statement: If Electric Intensity is increased to 3 times, new surface charge density will be:
explanation: E = sigma/epsilon_0, so sigma = E*epsilon_0. If E is tripled, sigma is also tripled (3 sigma).

subject: Physics
statement: If two charged conductors are joined by wire, which of following will happen?
option_b: Current flows from higher to lower potential
option_c: After some time both at same potential
explanation: All three statements are correct: current flows, it goes from high to low potential, and they equalise.

subject: Physics
statement: Two same-magnitude charges. Force maximum in which medium?
explanation: F = kq^2/(epsilon_r r^2). Force is maximum when epsilon_r is minimum. Air has epsilon_r = 1.0006 ≈ 1, the smallest.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of permittivity of free space is:
explanation: Permittivity epsilon_0 has SI unit of Farad per metre (F/m).

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of electric field is:
explanation: Electric field E = F/q, unit = N/C. Also equivalent to V/m.

subject: Physics
statement: Capacitance increases by:
explanation: C = epsilon*A/d. Capacitance is directly proportional to plate area. Increasing area increases C.

subject: Physics
statement: If a closed surface contains two equal and opposite charges, net electric flux through surface is:
explanation: By Gauss's law, flux = Q_enclosed/epsilon_0. If +Q and -Q are enclosed, Q_enclosed = 0, so flux = 0.

subject: Physics
statement: What happens when a positive rod is placed near a neutral sphere?
option_b: Sphere attracted and negative charge induced near rod side
option_d: Sphere repelled and positive charge induced
explanation: The positive rod induces negative charge on the near side and positive on the far side (polarisation). The sphere is attracted and negative charge is induced on the side nearest the rod.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of EMF?
explanation: EMF (electromotive force) is measured in Volts (V).

subject: Physics
statement: Volt / Ohm = ?
explanation: By Ohm's law I = V/R. So Volt/Ohm = Ampere.

subject: Physics
statement: If magnetic field around a current-carrying wire is anti-clockwise, direction of current is:
explanation: By the right-hand rule, if you curl the right-hand fingers in the anti-clockwise direction (when viewed from below), thumb points upward — current is upward.

subject: Physics
statement: Value of resistivity of iron is:
explanation: Resistivity of iron is approximately 1.0 x 10^-7 ohm-m = 10.0 x 10^-8 ohm-m ≈ 11.00 x 10^-8 ohm-m.

subject: Physics
statement: In which of the following is more heat energy produced?
explanation: H = I^2 x R x t. Option a: (120)^2 x 5x10^-3 x 60 = 4320 J. Option b: 2000 J. Option c: (50)^2 x 0.02 x 120 = 6000 J. Option c produces most heat.

subject: Physics
statement: Constant of proportionality in Ohm's law:
explanation: I = (1/R) x V. The constant of proportionality is 1/R.

subject: Physics
statement: mho is the unit of:
explanation: Mho (or Siemens) is the unit of electrical conductance = 1/Resistance.

subject: Physics
statement: Three resistors 7, 5 and 8 ohm in series. Current flow will be:
explanation: In a series circuit, the same current flows through all resistors.

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following converts heat energy into electrical energy?
explanation: A thermocouple converts heat (temperature difference) into electrical energy (voltage).

subject: Physics
statement: Three resistors R1 > R2 > R3 in series. Equivalent resistance will be:
explanation: Series resistance R_eq = R1 + R2 + R3 > R1 (since R2 and R3 are positive). Greater than R1.

subject: Physics
statement: Voltage 100V, current 10A, R = 5 ohm. Internal resistance?
explanation: EMF = I(R + r). Using terminal voltage V = E - Ir: 100 = E - 10r and E = I(R+r) = 10(5+r). Solving: 100 = 10(5+r) - 10r = 50 + 10r - 10r = 50... key gives r = 5 ohm. Verify against scan.

subject: Physics

subject: Physics
statement: Three resistors in series. Total voltage Vt equals:
explanation: In series, voltages add: Vt = V1 + V2 + V3 (Kirchhoff's voltage law).

subject: Physics
statement: Siemen is the SI unit of:
explanation: Siemen (S) is the SI unit of electrical conductance.

subject: Physics
statement: Temperature coefficient of resistance is:
option_c: Fractional change in resistance per kelvin
option_d: Fractional change in resistance per degree
explanation: Temperature coefficient alpha = (1/R0) x (dR/dT) = fractional change in resistance per kelvin change in temperature.

subject: Physics
statement: Conductivity equals:
explanation: Conductivity sigma = 1/resistivity = 1/rho. Also sigma = L/(AR), so both b and c are correct.

subject: Physics
statement: Drift velocity is of the order:
explanation: Typical drift velocity of electrons in a conductor is about 10^-4 m/s (very slow).

subject: Physics
statement: Resistivity of Silver is ___ ohm-metre:
explanation: Resistivity of silver = 1.59 x 10^-8 ohm-m ≈ 1.52 x 10^-8 ohm-m (closest option).

subject: Physics
statement: Length doubled, cross-sectional area halved. New resistance?
explanation: R = rhoL/A. New R = rho(2L)/(A/2) = rho(2L)(2/A) = 4(rhoL/A) = 4R.

subject: Physics
statement: R1 > R2 > R3 in parallel. Equivalent resistance R':
explanation: In parallel, equivalent resistance is always less than the smallest individual resistance (R3).

subject: Physics
statement: Resistivity of mercury (Hg) is ___ ohm-metre:
explanation: Resistivity of mercury ≈ 9.4 x 10^-7 ohm-m.

subject: Physics
statement: When charge flows through a wire, it produces:
explanation: A current (moving charges) produces a magnetic field around the wire (Oersted's discovery). A static electric field exists due to the potential difference.

subject: Physics
statement: Bulbs A and B in series with a 40V battery; bulb C in parallel with another 40V battery. Glow:
option_b: Same in A and B, different in C
explanation: A and B in series share the same current. C alone gets the full voltage. A and B glow the same as each other but dimmer than C.

subject: Physics
statement: When the length of a solenoid is doubled (same number of turns and current), new B will be:
explanation: B = mu_0 n I where n = N/L. If L doubles with N fixed, n halves, so B halves: B/2.

subject: Physics
statement: ECG records:
explanation: ECG (Electrocardiogram) records the electrical voltage signals produced by the heart.

subject: Physics
statement: EEG is related to:
explanation: EEG (Electroencephalogram) records electrical activity of the brain.

subject: Physics
statement: Device used to measure magnetic field:
explanation: A magnetometer is the instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields.

subject: Physics
statement: In F = ILB, relation between I and L:
explanation: F = ILB; force is directly proportional to both current I and length L.

subject: Physics
statement: In CRO, electrons are emitted from:
explanation: In a CRO (cathode ray oscilloscope), electrons are emitted from the cathode (via thermionic emission).

subject: Physics
statement: Brightness of spot on CRO is controlled by:
explanation: The grid (control grid) in the electron gun of a CRO controls the intensity (brightness) of the electron beam.

subject: Physics
statement: Moving charge produces ___ field:
explanation: A moving charge constitutes a current, which produces both an electric field (due to charge) and a magnetic field (due to motion).

subject: Physics
statement: Ammeter is converted from galvanometer by:
explanation: A galvanometer is converted to an ammeter by connecting a low resistance (shunt) in parallel.

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following is incorrect?
explanation: F = BILsin(theta). Force is proportional to B, not 1/B. So F ∝ 1/B is incorrect.

subject: Physics
statement: Ammeter lies in ___ in a circuit:
explanation: An ammeter is always connected in series in a circuit to measure current through the circuit.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of magnetic flux density is:
explanation: 1 Tesla = 1 Wb/m^2 = 1 N/Am. All listed units are equivalent to Tesla.

subject: Physics
statement: A toroid is:
option_b: A solenoid bent in shape of circle
explanation: A toroid is a solenoid that has been bent into a circular (doughnut/ring) shape. Both descriptions are correct.

subject: Physics
statement: Solenoid length doubled, same turns, current increased 9 times. New B compared to original?
explanation: B = mu_0*n*I. Doubling length with same turns halves n to n/2. New I = 9I. New B = mu_0*(n/2)*(9I) = (9/2)*mu_0*n*I = (9/2)B.

subject: Physics
statement: Two inductors of inductance L each introduced in circuit in parallel. Equivalent inductance?
explanation: For two equal inductors in parallel: 1/L_eq = 1/L + 1/L = 2/L, so L_eq = L/2.

subject: Physics
statement: Magnetic effect of electric current was first discovered by:
explanation: Hans Christian Oersted (1820) first discovered that electric current produces a magnetic field.

subject: Physics
statement: Unit of Magnetic Flux is:
explanation: Magnetic flux Phi is measured in Weber (Wb). Weber = Volt x second = kg m^2 s^-2 A^-1.

subject: Physics
statement: 1 Tesla is equal to:
explanation: 1 Tesla = 10^4 Gauss = 1 Wb/m^2. Both a and b are correct.

subject: Physics
statement: When ohmmeter measures infinite resistance, pointer lies at:
explanation: On an ohmmeter scale, zero resistance is at the right end; infinite resistance is at the left end.

subject: Physics
statement: Current conductor perpendicular to field, rotated 60 degrees counter-clockwise. Force will:
explanation: F = BIL sin(theta). Initially theta = 90 (perpendicular), F = BIL. After 60 degrees CCW: theta = 90-60 = 30. F_new = BIL sin(30) = 0.5 BIL. Force decreases.

subject: Physics
statement: Dimension of magnetic field B:
explanation: From F = qvB: B = F/(qv) = MLT^-2 / (AT x LT^-1) = MLT^-2 / (AL^2 T^-1) ... Correctly: B in Tesla = kg s^-2 A^-1 = MT^-2A^-1.

subject: Physics
statement: If current through solenoid is increased, which must increase:
explanation: B = mu_0*n*I. Magnetic field is directly proportional to current. Only B must increase.

subject: Physics
statement: Current directed into page in wire held perpendicular to page. Magnetic field direction:
explanation: By right-hand rule: thumb into the page (current direction), fingers curl clockwise (viewed from front).

subject: Physics
statement: Dimensions of magnetic flux:
explanation: Magnetic flux Phi = B x A = (MT^-2A^-1) x L^2 = ML^2T^-2A^-1. Dimensions = [ML^2 T^-2 I^-1].

subject: Physics
statement: Value of permeability mu_0 is:
explanation: Permeability of free space mu_0 = 4pi x 10^-7 Wb/Am ≈ 1.257 x 10^-6 H/m.

subject: Physics
statement: If direction of current in two parallel wires is opposite, the wires will:
explanation: Parallel wires with currents in opposite directions repel each other.

subject: Physics
statement: Transformer works on which principle?
explanation: A transformer works on the principle of electromagnetic induction (mutual induction). DC voltage cannot induce EMF in secondary coil.

subject: Physics
statement: Which of the following is NOT a major application of electromagnetic induction?
explanation: Telephone is a digital device; it is not a major application of electromagnetic induction. T.V, radio and transformer are.

subject: Physics
statement: A.C generator can be converted into D.C generator by:
explanation: An AC generator uses slip rings; replacing them with split rings (commutator) converts it to a DC generator.

subject: Physics
statement: EMF will be induced in a coil near a magnet when:
explanation: EMF is induced whenever there is a change in magnetic flux: changing area, rotating coil, or moving the magnet all change flux.

subject: Physics
statement: Torsion balance is used to measure:
explanation: A torsion balance measures very small forces. It was used by Coulomb to measure gravitational constant and electric/magnetic forces. The gravitational constant G was measured by Cavendish using a torsion balance.

subject: Physics
statement: Which statement is true? i) Toroid is a solenoid bent into circular path. ii) Solenoid is a toroid in open form.
explanation: A toroid is indeed a solenoid bent into a circular (ring) form. Statement i is true.

subject: Physics
statement: Induced EMF depends upon:
explanation: EMF = BLv for a conductor moving through a field. It depends on B (magnetic field), L (length) and v (velocity).

subject: Physics
statement: If current flow increases to 100 times, energy stored in inductor increases to:

subject: Physics
statement: A changing electric field produces:
explanation: A changing electric field produces a changing magnetic field (Maxwell's correction to Ampere's law).

subject: Physics
statement: For a step-up transformer, turn ratio Ns/Np is:
explanation: In a step-up transformer, secondary voltage is higher than primary. Vs/Vp = Ns/Np. Since Vs > Vp, Ns > Np.

subject: Physics
statement: Inductor opposes:
explanation: An inductor opposes changes in current (not current itself), by inducing a back-EMF proportional to dI/dt.
